The '''Yartiga system''' was located in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as the [[Yartigan well water]].<ref name="Farrimmer">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Yartigan well water]]|system=Yartiga [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Yartiga [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
